name: realearthstreetwar
description: This project is a prototype for a massively multiplayer online strategy game with a GTA1-style top-down view. The game world is a 1:1 representation of the real Earth, where players seek to convince others players and NPCs to perform tasks for them - joinging a gang, paying protection money, being an employee, joining your cult. Anything is possible. Or you canjust go on a rampage and destroy everything in sight.
